# doctrine/lexer (vendored)

Unmodified copy of `src/AbstractLexer.php`, `src/Token.php` and `LICENSE` from
<https://github.com/doctrine/lexer> at commit `51489dad40bc2361ba3ab022cde6cba10575dbea`.

- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`), Copyright (c) 2006-2018 Doctrine Project. MIT is compatible with
  EZE OS's GPL-2.0-only license.
- Used by the PHP bridge (`bridges/doctrine-php`) when it is run without Composer, and as the
  reference for the Python port in `ezeos/query/lexer.py`.
